subject: EU dedicated: confirmation on region pinning, backups, and deletion SLA
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novafin.eu>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-01-10T09:12:00Z
Subject: EU dedicated: region pinning and backup replication questions

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo yesterday. Novafin is evaluating Redwood Dedicated for a payments fraud model and we need to document a few controls for our security and procurement teams. Quick questions we weren't able to verify in the demo: 

1) If we choose a EU-only Dedicated pool (we plan to pin to eu-west1), can you confirm that primary model inference, logs, and KV cache live exclusively in that region?
2) Do any backups / snapshots (automatic or manual) replicate outside the pinned region by default? If so, what controls exist to prevent cross-region replication?
3) What is your deletion SLA and process if Novafin requests data erasure for a model + request logs tied to a particular tenant?

We're aiming to close procurement by end of month but need these confirmations to satisfy our internal legal and audit teams. If helpful, please attach architecture diagrams and the deletion playbook.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Information Security
Novafin Bank
[Attachment: procurement-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novafin.eu>
Cc: diego_fernandez@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-01-10T11:04:00Z
Subject: Re: EU dedicated: region pinning and backup replication questions

Elena — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Diego (infra) and Neha (legal/compliance) to provide concrete confirmations and the supporting artifacts. I'm attaching a concise region dataflow diagram and our deletion playbook for your review.

High-level answers while Diego prepares details:
- Primary inference, KV caches, and request logs for a pinned Dedicated pool are kept in the pinned region for active data.
- Backups and snapshots: we offer a configurable policy — by default scheduled snapshots are stored in the same region, but some customers enable multi-region replication for DR. We will confirm default behavior and options for Novafin to ensure EU-only storage.
- Deletion SLA: we support tenant-level data wipe with a 7-day completion target for active data and 30-day certification window for backups/archival systems; legal will confirm retention exceptions for audit logs.

Diego / Neha — can you confirm whether any internal telemetry or control plane logs are routed to US for our standard control plane? Novafin requires the control plane to avoid storing any tenant-sensitive logs outside EU unless explicitly consented.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novafin.eu>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-01-11T07:30:00Z
Subject: Re: EU dedicated: region pinning and backup replication questions

Hi Elena,

Thanks — listing concrete technical confirmations below and attaching the EU dataflow diagram. TL;DR: we can operate Novafin's Dedicated pool in an EU-only configuration with control plane metadata minimization. Details: 

- Serving and ephemeral artifacts: inference requests, model weights loaded into GPUs, KV caches, and per-request telemetry (token counts, latency metrics) are stored in eu-west1 by default for a pinned pool.

- Control plane: by default, the Redwood control plane runs globally for orchestration signals. However, for Private/Dedicated enterprise customers we offer a control-plane partition that limits tenant metadata to EU control-plane nodes. That setup also prevents automatic shipping of tenant logs to US analytics clusters.

- Backups and snapshots: automated snapshots are taken daily and, in the EU-only policy, are written to eu-west1 object storage buckets. We do not replicate snapshots outside the pinned region unless the \"Cross-region DR\" flag is explicitly enabled on the account. Manual backup downloads (for SRE/ops) can be gated behind an approval workflow and are logged.

- Deletion and certification: 
  - Active data wipe: when Novafin requests tenant wipe, job kicks off immediately and active artifacts (KV caches, model checkpoints for dedicated tenant instances, and request logs) are removed; completion expected within 7 calendar days.
  - Backups/archival: we run a secure purge pipeline that targets regional object stores; depending on storage provider retention windows, purge completes and is certified within 30 days.
  - Audit evidence: we can provide a signed deletion certificate plus S3 object lifecycle purge logs and a timeline.

- Edge cases / exceptions: legally required retention (e.g., court order) may delay full purging; also some control-plane operational logs (aggregated non-tenant content) may remain on global observability clusters but are redacted and cannot be traced to tenants.

I'll coordinate with infra to generate a sample deletion certificate for your compliance team.

Regards,
Diego Fernandez
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: rwd-eu-dataflow-diagram.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novafin.eu>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: diego_fernandez@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-01-11T12:26:00Z
Subject: Re: EU dedicated: region pinning and backup replication questions

Elena — quick legal/compliance confirmation and a couple of mitigations we propose for Novafin’s policy requirements: 

1) We can contractually guarantee that tenant data for a pinned Dedicated pool will not be replicated outside the EU region unless Novafin explicitly authorizes cross-region DR. This is codified as a configuration option in the Dedicated SOW.

2) Control-plane logs: we will add a clause that limits Redwood from retaining tenant-identifying control-plane logs outside the EU for the Novafin deployment. Aggregated operational telemetry remains useful for platform health; we will supply proofs of redaction and sampling strategy.

3) Deletion certification: Redwood will provide a deletion certificate and export of purge logs within 30 days of a verified erase request. If Novafin requires a shorter certification window (e.g., 14 days), we can evaluate as a contractual SLA depending on storage provider constraints.

Please let us know if your auditors require a specific format for the deletion certificate or additional evidence (e.g., signed manifest + KMS key rotation log).

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Legal & Compliance, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: deletion-playbook-2027.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novafin.eu>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, diego_fernandez@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, Procurement Team <procurement@novafin.eu>
Date: 2027-01-12T15:48:00Z
Subject: Re: EU dedicated: region pinning and backup replication questions

Karthik / team — this is very helpful, thank you. A couple of follow-ups from our audit checklist: 

- Can you confirm whether cold archival snapshots (retained for compliance) are ever migrated to a vendor-managed multi-region house (we require EU-only archival storage)?
- For the deletion certificate, our auditors ask for a signed manifest that includes: tenant id, objects purged (prefixes), timestamps, and the KMS key id(s) used. Would Redwood be able to provide that format?

If you can confirm those two points and share the two attachments internally with procurement/legal, we can proceed to final review. Happy to jump on a 30-minute call if that speeds things up.

Best,
Elena
Head of Information Security
Novafin Bank
